release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob and Vampire.
Detect keyboard closure at the Android window so a typed message sends automatically and an empty input closes without a second Back action.
Preserve pending dismissal across brief keyboard-window focus changes.
Auto-hide the phone status bar throughout app screens; swipe from the top to reveal it temporarily.
Show bouncing dots above a player profile while they type in the lobby; clear automatically on stop, send or disconnect.
